description: This file exports constants and module definitions related to a flowchart rendering library, including functions for creating SVG elements, styling, and drawing flowcharts.

methods.name: l
methods.description: Creates a foreignObject SVG element with a nested XHTML div, inserting content based on label type, and adjusting size accordingly.

methods.name: o
methods.description: Checks if a given SVG element has children with a specific tag.

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns a string combining the 'v', 'w', and 'name' properties of an object, separated by colons.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Sets the style attribute of an SVG element.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Adds or appends CSS classes to an SVG element.

methods.name: p
methods.description: Retrieves the transition for a graph if available.
